            if neg:

                    # Stop at the first AMOUNT to the right on that header row.
                    candidates.append((row, p_col, a_col))
                    break

left_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c[2] < min_col]

    header_row, particulars_col, amount_col = max(left_candidates, key=«redacted» c: (c[2], c[1]))
elif candidates:
